title: 姚明：篮球才是世界第一运动？世界杯也挡不住
speaker: Yao Ming

segments.en: The eyes of the sporting world may be on the FIFA World Cup right now, but Chinese basketball star Yao Ming says his sport is still the most popular internationally.
segments.zh: 虽然现在全世界的体育目光都聚焦在世界杯上，但中国篮球明星姚明表示，篮球仍然是国际上最受欢迎的运动。

segments.en: The NBA Hall of Famers spoke to us about the global reach of the top US leagues and how the sport connects America and China.
segments.zh: 这位NBA名人堂成员向我们讲述了美国顶级联赛的全球影响力，以及篮球如何连接中美两国。

segments.en: Basketball is a most popular sports in the world.
segments.zh: 篮球是世界上最受欢迎的运动。
